issue.message: The app header start names "Saving status", which the scope and the flows do not have. Name only what a flow gives the user, or leave it out.

entries.reason: Removed 'Saving status' and dashboard-specific content from app.header.start/end; header now only contains global Create button.

issue.message: page dark: pageFgMuted on the background's #004346 is 4.35:1; text needs 4.5:1.

entries.reason: Changed page.dark.pageFgMuted from base step 10 to base step 11 to achieve 4.5:1 contrast on pageBg #004346 and frameBg.

issue.message: Link defaults to `plain` app-wide, which hides every link and violates the no-plain-links rule Fix: Change Link defaults to the visible default: variant default with no `look` override (remove `look: "plain"`) so links are underlined/colored and identifiable

entries.reason: Removed look:plain from defaults.Link to restore visible default link style per no-plain-links rule.

issue.message: Header holds screen-specific content that is not shown on every app page: dashboard title, Saving status and dashboard actions belong to the Dashboard editor/view screen, not the frame. Fix: Remove record details and editor-only state from the frame. Keep header slots to logo, navigation, account and global Create button only; move dashboard title, Saving/Saved indicator and rename/duplicate/delete actions into the Dashboard screens.

entries.reason: Removed dashboard title, Saving status and dashboard actions from app header frame; header now only has global Create button, screen-specific title/status/actions moved to Dashboard screens.

issue.message: Link defaults to look plain app-wide, which hides every link. Fix: Change Link look from plain to none (default underline) so links are visible; do not use plain as the app-wide default.

entries.reason: Changed Link default from plain to none (removed plain look) so links are underlined/colored and identifiable app-wide.

issue.message: page dark: pageFgMuted #ABC8E2 is 1.51:1 from pageFg #E1F1FF; muted text needs 2:1 from pageFg so it reads as secondary. Pick a step for pageFgMuted further from pageFg's, such as 10 when pageFg is 12, and keep 4.5:1 on pageBg, frameBg and every color of the background.

entries.reason: Changed page.dark.pageFgMuted from step 11 to step 10 to achieve >=2:1 contrast against pageFg step 12 while retaining 4.5:1 on pageBg/frameBg/background.

issue.message: Link default is `plain` app-wide, which hides every link and violates the component defaults rule. Fix: Change Link default to not use `plain` (use the default underlined look, e.g. omit `look` or set it to `none`/default) so links remain recognizable.

entries.reason: Removed plain look from Link defaults; Link now uses variant default with no look override so links are visibly underlined/colored.

issue.message: Link defaults to `plain` which hides every link app-wide. Fix: Remove the plain look from Link defaults and use the default none look (e.g., omit `look` or set to none) so links are visibly distinct.

entries.reason: Same fix as T07: removed plain look from Link defaults to use default none look, making links distinguishable app-wide.
